name: AXM Deterministic Run Integrator
actions: create one exact isolated run worktree outside the target repository
hash and bind every changed path to an explicit policy and target head
hold on target drift, dirty state, undeclared or private paths, configured Git filters, conflicts, symlinks, and secret-shaped content
with exact confirmation seal one deterministic local commit and fast-forward the unchanged target
remove the integrated worktree and run branch, or preserve the lane when recovery is required
summary: Turn one isolated builder run into a declared, deterministic local fast-forward transaction without re-dirtying the active Workshop.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL high-consequence local Git gate. It executes no builder or tests and cannot write remotes/main, rewrite history, promote, alter roots, or change CANON.
